The Blackmailers' Lair

A dying note reveals that blackmailers attacked Aunt Zara's caravan. They also hold a caravan driver prisoner and may use him to demand even more. Destroy the gang, rescue the driver and escort him to Aunt Zara.

Objectives

Find the blackmailers' house

Overhear the conversation

Kill the blackmailers' accomplice

Free the caravan driver

Escort the caravan driver to Aunt Zara
